prompt:
A clean, friendly, flat vector architecture illustration for a software documentation page, wide landscape, light off-white background, calm palette of deep blue, teal and soft grey with one small amber accent, generous whitespace, no photographs, no gradients, no 3D, no shadows beyond a very soft one. Left to right, three clearly separated zones joined by two thick rounded arrows.

Zone 1 (left): a simple flat illustration of a person at a laptop and a phone, with the single label "Webbläsare".

Zone 2 (centre, the largest): one big rounded container with the label "Modulen". Inside it two stacked rounded cards: the upper card shows a simplified app window with a microphone icon and a small waveform, label "Gränssnitt"; the lower card shows a shield with a padlock and a key, label "Säker backend". A thin small ribbon above the container holds three tiny icons (a logo mark, a name tag, a colour swatch) with the label "Egen logga, namn och färg".

Zone 3 (right): a rounded platform block with the label "Eneo", showing a small flow diagram icon of connected nodes and a document icon.

Arrow 1 from Zone 1 to Zone 2 carries a small cookie icon. Arrow 2 from Zone 2 to Zone 3 carries a small key icon and a small person-badge icon; a thinner return arrow below it carries a document icon. Use ONLY these Swedish labels and spell them exactly: Webbläsare, Modulen, Gränssnitt, Säker backend, Eneo, Egen logga, namn och färg. No other text anywhere, no numbers, no lorem ipsum. Balanced composition, crisp edges, consistent line weight, suitable for a README header.
